horizon.known_runtime_issue: First product attempt hit the 15-second watchdog in Java lifecycle stop. Two subsequent product resumes returned successfully with the unchanged 15-second deadline; the initial timeout cause remains unproven. The separate 60-second experiment is not a production change. A portrait session also failed the frame-hash gate because readback uses physical traversal order while the VM hash uses logical order. Reconstructing the preserved frame in rotation 1 reproduces the VM hash exactly; no raw result was rewritten. This verification limitation remains open.
